description: ARIMA safety guard (blocks secret-file access, merges and pushes to the default branch, Notion deletes, writes to protected state) and audit log. Active only inside ARIMA projects (a folder with arima.yaml).

hooks.command: command -v node >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "ARIMA guard cannot run because Node.js was not found, so this action is blocked to be safe. Install Node.js 22 or newer." >&2; exit 2; }; node "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/dist/arima-hook.mjs" pre-tool-use
